notice: From the official State of Rhode Island sample ballot for the November 3, 2026 general election (East Greenwich Precinct 0901, posted by the East Greenwich Town Clerk); statewide offices and questions are the same statewide. Confirm on your official sample ballot.
gaps: County, municipal and legislative races not yet loaded.

The Rhode Island Department of State and Board of Elections websites (vote.sos.ri.gov, elections.ri.gov) blocked automated access on 2026-10-31, so statewide candidates and questions come from an official town sample ballot rather than the state's certified list.
Rhode Island has no statewide judicial elections.

measures.title: Higher Education Facilities - $275,000,000
measures.summary: Authorizes $275 million in state bonds for capital improvements at Rhode Island's public colleges: $165 million for a University of Rhode Island Integrated Health Building, $50 million for renovations to Rhode Island College's Adams Library, and $60 million for a Community College of Rhode Island Workforce Innovation Center. Part of a bond act passed by the General Assembly at its 2026 session (Chapter 084, Public Laws 2026).
measures.yesMeans: You approve letting the State of Rhode Island borrow by issuing bonds and notes of up to $275 million for these higher education buildings.
measures.noMeans: You reject this bond, and the state may not borrow this money for these projects.

measures.title: Housing and Homeownership - $120,000,000
measures.summary: Authorizes $120 million in state bonds to increase and preserve affordable and accessible housing through redevelopment, new construction, property acquisition and infrastructure. At least $25 million must go to producing homes for homeownership, and up to $10 million may support public housing development. Part of a bond act passed by the General Assembly at its 2026 session (Chapter 084, Public Laws 2026).
measures.yesMeans: You approve letting the State of Rhode Island borrow by issuing bonds and notes of up to $120 million for affordable housing and homeownership.
measures.noMeans: You reject this bond, and the state may not borrow this money for these projects.

measures.title: Economic Development - $100,000,000
measures.summary: Authorizes $100 million in state bonds for economic development: $55 million for site development and $45 million for growth-industry infrastructure. Part of a bond act passed by the General Assembly at its 2026 session (Chapter 084, Public Laws 2026).
measures.yesMeans: You approve letting the State of Rhode Island borrow by issuing bonds and notes of up to $100 million for site development and growth-industry infrastructure.
measures.noMeans: You reject this bond, and the state may not borrow this money for these projects.

measures.title: Cultural Economy - $50,000,000
measures.summary: Authorizes $50 million in state bonds for the cultural economy: $45 million for a State History Center and $5 million for the State Preservation Grants Program. Part of a bond act passed by the General Assembly at its 2026 session (Chapter 084, Public Laws 2026).
measures.yesMeans: You approve letting the State of Rhode Island borrow by issuing bonds and notes of up to $50 million for a State History Center and preservation grants.
measures.noMeans: You reject this bond, and the state may not borrow this money for these projects.

measures.title: Green Economy Bonds - $55,000,000
measures.summary: Authorizes $55 million in state bonds for environmental and recreational projects, including $25 million for the Resilient Rhody Infrastructure Fund, $12 million for facility improvements, $7 million for Narragansett Bay watershed restoration, $3 million each for brownfields cleanup, farmland preservation and open space, and $1 million each for local recreation and marine infrastructure. Part of a bond act passed by the General Assembly at its 2026 session (Chapter 084, Public Laws 2026).
measures.yesMeans: You approve letting the State of Rhode Island borrow by issuing bonds and notes of up to $55 million for these environmental and recreation projects.
measures.noMeans: You reject this bond, and the state may not borrow this money for these projects.
